title: Gender Disambiguation in Machine Translation: Diagnostic Evaluation in Decoder-Only Architectures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation outputs using Standard Gender Accuracy on the WinoMT dataset, Minimal Pair Accuracy (MPA) by swapping contextual gender cues to test consistency, and measuring a novel 'Prior Bias' metric on a neutralized dataset (using 'they/them'). The study additionally employs attention-based analysis to probe how internal self-attention mechanisms integrate contextual gender cues during translation.
